capabilities.effect: Validate research-document metadata and project terms and citations without tying that policy to one Markdown parser or a knowledge-system server.

modernEvidence.effect: Observes commit ancestry, refs, the tracked tree and bounded path history as immutable Git data with Git object identities as integrity witnesses.

capabilities.effect: Admit, retrieve, and categorize typed named relation predicates, including reciprocal inverse declarations, as reusable semantic data rather than as an RRP-specific enum and registry.
capabilities.rationale: Predicate vocabulary is upstream semantic data. modernEvidence.effect: Admits typed named predicate vocabularies, validates inverse pairs, and supports definition and category lookup.

capabilities.effect: Decode relationing cell, morphism, and contextual-scope declarations from a Markdown carrier into source-positioned semantic annotation data, including structural scope diagnostics, without owning a Pandoc filter process, database, registry file, or export route.

Its Panflute spans, global mutable graph, local registry loading, filesystem report writes, and ad-hoc JSON-LD/Turtle/DOT/CSV emit switch were a coupled presentation application and are retired. A downstream receiver may admit the decoded declarations to SignCell or render them through its own explicit policy.

modernEvidence.effect: Projects relationing annotations, their definitions and references, source positions, scopes, and unmatched-scope diagnostics from one Markdown carrier as immutable data.
